attributes.name: Blood Kineticist
attributes.powers:
On your combat or Fortitude check, discard this card to add 2d4; you may additionally recharge any number of allies to add their adventure deck numbers. 

Discard this card to explore your location. During this exploration, you may discard an ally to add 1d8 to your check to acquire a boon.
